notes: All rows come from the map-area polygon (~1.2 km x 1.5 km around пр. Аль-Фараби / Бухар жырау / Жошы хан / Керей-Жанибек хандар), so besides BI Capital Park queues (Emotions 1-2, Melody, Art, Vector, Flowers, Light, Water) it includes neighbouring non-BI ЖК (Sandi Qala, Abat, Jana Qala, Samal Park, Tribeca, Amal, Арнау, Камал, Адал, Жана Урпак/Бастау/Омир, Vienna, Варшава, G-Park Family, Noho, Olen, Dos, Brooklyn). Basement detection is from title/truncated snippet only, so basement=false means 'not mentioned'. Several units are re-posted under multiple ids (e.g. Capital Park Emotions 130 m² @144 M ₸ x5; Tribeca 73.98 m² x4 and 56 m² x3; Sandi Qala 101.25 m² @1 M ₸ x3); these are flagged 'probable repost'. Many 'Склады' rows are 2-10 m² storage closets in residential parkings (flagged tiny). Some listings print 'Нура р-н' for Жошы хан 12 / Бухар жырау addresses — agent error, they are in Есильский. 1015434094 and 1012295432 (862.3 m², Бухар жырау 25/1, ~820-829 M ₸) look like the same object listed twice with different prices. Clean medians (excl. flagged price errors, whole buildings, units <15 m², and probable reposts): rent 10235 ₸/m²/month (n=123), sale 1220595 ₸/m² (n=98).
